verdicts.reason: A: the label frame sits empty in the middle with orphaned divider rules inside it. All the text is pulled out onto the bare background, with 'Homemade Lotion' cut off from the brand block, and the illustrations are shrunk to a tiny strip, so the design no longer holds together. B: it keeps the label card with the text in it and the illustrations spread around, but the divider rules have broken loose and float on the right, and one of them runs into the plant illustration. The text inside the card is small, 'Skincare' is barely readable, and the products are scattered with gaps between them instead of grouped.
